text: Artificial Intelligence helps computers perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. It is used in healthcare, education and business.
Online education allows students to learn from anywhere. It provides flexibility and access to digital learning resources.
The new mobile application is very useful and easy to operate. Customers are happy with its performance.
Technology has changed communication. People can now communicate through emails, video calls and social media.
Machine learning is a branch of AI that enables computers to learn patterns from data and make predictions.
